name: Ivan Duane Forester
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Cox Family Tree" (tree 17224056)
notes: Son of Charles Elmer and Etta (Burch) Forester. Born 22 Jul 1899 in Michigan; died 14 Feb 1989 at Zephyrhills, Florida; buried at Montgomery, Hillsdale County, Michigan. He and his wife Vera Munger had a son Max and three other children, living in the tree.
